title: SplitButton
description: A primary Fiori action paired with an arrow for related commands.

usage.summary: Run a common action directly and keep alternatives available from the adjacent arrow.
useWhen: Give users a shortcut to the most common action, such as exporting to PDF, while offering other formats in a menu.
Use the same design for both action parts and give the primary action a clear label.

avoidWhen.when: All commands require opening the menu first.
